## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f7e9df2dc7d58acf9fe82a92da1028ae691fc904`
Local-runs: none
Scope: every path of the diff outside the prose faces (the changeset `.changeset/30511-console-packs-platform-locale-tags.md` is read for ②, not reviewed; no `content/docs/**` or `apps/docs/**` path is in the diff) — `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`, `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/**` (`package.json`, `README.md`, `tsconfig.test.json`, `scripts/{gen-zh-hant.mjs,zh-hant.mjs,zh-hant.d.mts}`, `src/{i18n.ts,index.ts,provider.tsx}`, `src/locales/{index.ts,registry.ts,zh-Hans.ts,zh-Hant.ts,pt-BR.ts}`, `src/namespaces/marketplace/{index.ts,zh-Hans.ts,zh-Hant.ts,pt-BR.ts}`, 70 `src/__tests__/*`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/{chrome/LoadingScreen.tsx,console/ai/outboundAgentText.ts,utils/flowResponse.ts,hooks/useUserLocale.ts}`, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, `ui/scripts/{check-eager-locale-catalogues,check-i18n-dead-keys,check-i18n-en-drift,check-lint-rule-coverage}.mjs` and their `__tests__`, `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/docs/verification/README.md`, and the ~60 test files under `ui/apps/console`, `ui/packages/{app-shell,components,fields,plugin-*}` + cited: `packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts` (the published table, `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES`, `platformLocaleTagOf`), `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (`resolveLocaleAmong`), `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` (`SYS_USER_LOCALE_TAG_PATTERN`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx`, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/index.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts`, `ui/packages/components/src/lib/date-fns-locale.ts`, `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md`. The lockfile and the two generated `zh-Hant.ts` catalogues are read for shape (header, line alignment, `export default zhHant`), not reviewed line by line.

### ① Derived judgments

Public surface, `@object-ui/i18n` (exports map unchanged: `.`, `./locales`, `./locales/*`, `./namespaces/studio`, `./namespaces/marketplace`):

- `.` entry gains `resolveBuiltInLanguage(code): string | null` — RIGHT (widening; the one resolver every reader keyed by the old codes now goes through).
- `./locales` entry: `builtInLocales` keys are the table's tags in table order (`zh` → `zh-Hans`, `pt` → `pt-BR`, `zh-Hant` added), `satisfies` a Record keyed by `PlatformLocaleTag`; named exports `zh`/`pt` KEPT as identifiers (now the `zh-Hans`/`pt-BR` catalogues), `zhHant` added — RIGHT (narrowing of the key set, declared in the changeset with FROM → TO; the identifier exports are deliberately not renamed, which the header says).
- `./locales/*`: `@object-ui/i18n/locales/zh` and `/pt` no longer resolve (files renamed); `/zh-Hans`, `/zh-Hant`, `/pt-BR` new — RIGHT, declared, migration lines present.
- `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES` is `[...PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS]` (11 entries, `zh`/`pt` gone); type `readonly string[]` unchanged — RIGHT, declared.
- `getLoadedBuiltInLocales()` keyed by tag; `loadBuiltInLocale` / `isBuiltInLocaleLoaded` / `isBuiltInLanguage` accept every table tag, every read alias, and any longer tag by prefix walk (`zh-Hant-TW`, `fr-CA`, `pt-PT` → `pt-BR`) — RIGHT: the accept set is a superset of `main`'s (exact-then-base), and `pt-PT`→`pt-BR` preserves `main`'s base-language behaviour; the spec's "`pt-PT` is not `pt-BR`" is a statement about `platformLocaleTagOf`, whose doc itself separates "means" from "serves", and the server's `resolveLocaleAmong` steps 4–5 serve `pt-PT` with `pt-BR` too, so Console and server agree.
- `matchLanguageTag` unchanged; now documented as the generic matcher for non-table sets (provider seed, `studio`) — RIGHT.
- `pickInitialLanguage` (exported) answers a TAG for a built-in match (`zh-TW` → `zh-Hant`, `pt-PT` → `pt-BR`) instead of the base language; an app `resources` key by base language still wins — RIGHT, and the only way a Taiwan browser reaches Traditional; it is a behavioural change on a public function and the changeset's "stored codes keep working" paragraph covers it only implicitly (see ② note).
- `createI18n` `fallbackLng` becomes an object: each tag → `[fallback]`, each read alias → `[tag, fallback]`, plus `default` — RIGHT; i18next's object lookup (code, script part, formatted code, language part, default) reaches `zh-Hant-TW` → `zh-Hant` and `pt-PT` → `pt` → `pt-BR` as the docblock says; an instance in a stored alias renders its tag's bundle without a second copy.
- `I18nProvider` boot effect and `changeLanguage` write a built-in catalogue under its TAG, never the alias (the double-write/`added` re-render fix, pinned in `provider-load-rerender-10382`) — RIGHT; the instance language, the document `lang` attribute and the stored value stay what the user had (`zh-CN`, `zh-TW`).
- `./namespaces/marketplace`: `MARKETPLACE_LOADERS` typed as a Record keyed by `PlatformLocaleTag`, `MARKETPLACE_LANGUAGE_CODES` are tags, `resolveMarketplaceLanguage` goes through `resolveBuiltInLanguage`, `hasMarketplaceCatalogue` is a type guard, catalogue stored under the tag — RIGHT, consistent with the packs.
- `./namespaces/studio` untouched: `en` + `zh`, `matchLanguageTag` base match; a `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant`/`zh-TW` instance reaches `zh` through i18next's language-part step — RIGHT per ruling #25922 (Traditional readers get Simplified Studio strings; declared in the changeset).

`@object-ui/app-shell`: `LoadingScreen`, `outboundAgentText` (`PACK_TAG` `zh` → `zh-Hans`), `flowResponse` read the snapshot by `resolveBuiltInLanguage` — RIGHT. `pickRenderableLocale` = `resolveLocaleAmong` (spec), so the Console's `sys_user.locale` pick has the server's table step (`zh-TW` offered `zh-Hans`+`zh-Hant` → `zh-Hant`; `es` offered `es-MX`,`es-ES` → `es-ES`) — RIGHT, and it closes spec#3's note 6665575988. Exported surface of app-shell (`hasSignInLanguagePick`, `saveSignInLanguagePick`, `LocaleSwitcher`) unchanged. `LocaleSwitcher` itself is not edited: it enumerates `offerableLanguages`, so the menu now offers `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `pt-BR`, labelled by `Intl.DisplayNames` because the hand-kept `zh`/`pt` label rows no longer match — RIGHT for phase 2 (phase 4 owns the menu), see ④ S2.

`@object-ui/components`: `translateLabel` picks the Traditional dictionary rows for any locale `resolveBuiltInLanguage` reads as `zh-Hant` (`zh-Hant`, `zh-HK`, `zh-MO`), Simplified otherwise — RIGHT. `date-fns-locale.ts` (unchanged, read) resolves `zh-Hans` → `zh-CN`, `zh-Hant` → `zh-TW`, `pt-BR` exact through `Intl.Locale.maximize()` — no regression.

`@object-ui/console`: `vite.config.ts` one `i18n-locale-TAG` / `i18n-ns-marketplace-TAG` group per table tag — RIGHT (the eager gate reads these names).

Gates (edits to existing checks, no new `check:*`, per ruling F):
- `check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`: `LOCALES = [...PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS]`; a FOLLOWER pack absent at the base reads as empty and is named; `en` absent at base, or any pack absent at HEAD, still throws — RIGHT (the renamed/new packs' keys are a key-set fact the parity test owns; the excuse is before-side only and pinned both ways in `check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts` and `git-paths-nested-layout.test.ts`). The `en`-first assertion at lines 194–196 is WRONG as spelled: a top-level `if (LOCALES[0] !== 'en') { throw … }` in a `scripts/**` module that exports bindings runs on import, which is exactly what `ui/scripts/check-entry-guard.mjs` refuses ("export bindings AND run on import"); the head's `Lint UI` job reds on it (④ M1). The assertion belongs inside a declaration (a function the `LOCALES` initialiser calls), not at module top.
- `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs`: map-chain tag stripping reads `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS` (`PACK_MAP_TAGS`), `PACK_EXPORT_NAMES` gains `zhHant` — RIGHT (previously it stripped export identifiers as if they were tags; the two sets are now distinct).
- `check-eager-locale-catalogues.mjs`: explicit 11-tag list kept on purpose; its test pins the list to the table AND to the registry's loader table, and pins that each loader imports the file named for its tag — RIGHT.
- `check-lint-rule-coverage.mjs`: `UNREACHED_GROUPS` row for `packages/i18n/scripts/zh-hant.d.mts`, card `objectstack#30511`; tests accept an `objectstack#` card — RIGHT.
- `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`: `zh-Hant.ts` as `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` with `gen:zh-hant` — RIGHT (no `check:` currency proof exists, so a `REGEN_ARTIFACTS` row would be wrong; the package test is the proof). Note the marketplace `zh-Hant.ts` catalogue is NOT listed there — minor, see ④ S5.

Tests that make the card's ask real: `all-locales-key-parity` pins `Object.keys(builtInLocales)` equal to `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS` (a table tag with no pack reds by name); `region-locale-fallback-11326` covers both scripts with a probe key spelled differently in each pack (保存/儲存) and fresh module graphs; `zh-hant-generated` is byte-for-byte over `ZH_HANT_TARGETS` with a counter-probe on the list; `userLocale-10059` pins the table step. the `satisfies` and Record-keyed-by-`PlatformLocaleTag` typing makes a table drift a compile error in two places. RIGHT.

Generator: `zh-hant.mjs` ports the site's `s2twp` + `TWP_PHRASE_OVERRIDES` + `LOCATIVE_LI`, adds `STRADDLE_OVERRIDES` (segmentation + group 0) and one phrase override, refuses to write when a pinned `CONVERSION_CASES` entry fails, keeps the six `GATE_ONLY_KEYS` out of the pack as comments so line numbers stay aligned (5034 lines both files). `opencc-js` pinned `1.3.1` as a devDependency; the converter never ships. RIGHT.

Head check-runs on `f7e9df2d` (the gate verdicts, all completed): `Lint UI` — **failure**, step "Verify every ui scripts entry guard goes through one predicate": `check:entry-guard` names `scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs:194` (`if () {}` at module top in a file that exports bindings). `Test UI (15/16)` — **cancelled** ("a higher priority waiting request for ci-CI-pull_request-30902 exists": the PR received a newer push, `143ef31d`, at 10:25Z and the concurrency group pre-empted this shard), so the aggregate `Test UI` reads failure and the `CI` workflow run reads cancelled; shard 15 is UNMEASURED on this head, not red. Everything else is green: Test UI shards 1–14 and 16, Test Core (1/8, 2/8, aggregate), TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / source gates / debt ledger, Build Core, Build UI Deps, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Build Docs, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · ESLint, every scoped Lint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Validate Package Dependencies, Dogfood Regression Gate; the opt-in/scheduled jobs are `skipped`. One derived gate is red on this head, so the gate verdict is red.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` on both the PR body and the changeset body, line-initial, with the widening and the narrowing each spelled out; `Metadata-protocol: none` — correct: no spec key, metadata type or authorable value changes. Level: `patch` on `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/console` — the four released packages whose shipped code the diff changes (`fields` and the `plugin-*` packages carry test edits only). Per AGENTS.md "Add a changeset": kind `none` ⇒ `patch`, and a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` with its BREAKING banner, FROM → TO migration (five lines: the two `builtInLocales` members, the two `./locales/*` modules, and the code-comparison rewrite) and exactly one ADR-0087 marker — all present; marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is a category the gate knows (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`) and the reason given (the rename is a source rewrite on a subpath that `runtime-export-retired` cannot take as operand; root entry retires nothing) is true of the tree. `Check Changeset` is green on the head. Should-note, not a defect: the changeset's "Stored codes keep working" paragraph does not name `pickInitialLanguage`'s changed answer (`zh` → `zh-Hans` for a Chinese browser with no stored choice); it is implied by "a browser code … read through the table's aliases".

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — the record agrees with the declaration; `patch` is the right level. The FAIL below is a gate finding (④ M1), not a semver one.

### ③ Boundary flags

os-dev-report 6682318861 carries no `open_questions` key and no `dev flag`; what it does raise:

- `deviations[0]` one REST read of #30595's body via `gh api` — read-only, no bearing on the tree.
- `deviations[1]` heavy runs measured on `e94c13c8ad`/`d06324827a`, the final head rechecked with targeted suites — answered by the head's own check-runs (the gate verdicts of record); the local readings are not relied on here.
- `owed_by_others`: this record (done); Tier H human approval via `os-zhuang` (size > 3,000 lines; the seat requests it after this record); close #30595 (seat, at landing).
- `skills_docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md`: read in the live tree, its "Built-in locales" list still names ten packs with `zh` and `pt`. `skills/**` is a Tier H governed surface, so it cannot ride in this PR without the maintainer's hand; the follow-up card must be FILED before this PR lands (see ④ S3), not merely "owed".
- `adr_0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: upheld (see ②); the subpath-operand gap is filed as #30598.
- `serials`: #30640 merged and its namespace is re-tagged here with a generated `zh-Hant`; #30601 merged and `pickRenderableLocale` calls `resolveLocaleAmong`; #30721's studio keys untouched (`studio` stays `en`+`zh`); #30840's `install.preview` keys present in `zh-Hans`/`pt-BR`/`zh-Hant` — all consistent with the tree.
- Carried from the superseded report 6664349306 `out_of_scope_findings`: `pickLocalized` zh-Hant inline maps (→ ④ S1, not filed yet); server `resolveLocale` read aliases (→ landed as #30601, resolved); `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` (→ ④ S3); ADR-0087 subpath operand (→ #30598, filed).
- spec#3 note 6665575988 (Console ladder lacked the table step): resolved in this head.

Nothing escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the published spec on `main` (`packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts`): the table declares (a) one pack per tag on every surface, (b) stored values written before the table keep resolving through `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES`, (c) new writes use the table's tags, (d) a closed alias list with no guessed region/script fallback in `platformLocaleTagOf` itself, and (e) a `label` per row for language menus. This diff makes (a) real for the Console (the parity suite and two Record-keyed-by-`PlatformLocaleTag` types turn a table/pack mismatch red), honours (b) at every reader found (registry, i18next `fallbackLng`, provider boot and switch, marketplace namespace, `LoadingScreen`, `outboundAgentText`, `flowResponse`, `translateLabel`, `pickRenderableLocale`), and does (c) at the two write sites (`LocaleSwitcher` → `useLanguageSelection` → `sys_user.locale`, and the device slot), where the server's `locale_bcp47_shape` rule (`SYS_USER_LOCALE_TAG_PATTERN`) accepts `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant`/`pt-BR` and the server's `resolveLocaleAmong` table step serves a stored `zh-Hans` from its `zh-CN` catalogue. Nothing a consumer could do on `main` is taken away: `builtInLocales.zh` / `.pt` and the two module paths are the only removals, each with a one-line rewrite, and every code that used to load a pack still loads one (a strict superset). The Console's prefix walk beyond the closed alias list (`pt-PT` → `pt-BR`, `fr-CA` → `fr`) does not contradict (d): the spec separates "which tag a code MEANS" from "which key SERVES it", and the serving ladder it publishes (`resolveLocaleAmong` steps 4–5) answers `pt-PT` with `pt-BR` as well. Attempts to break it: a stored `zh`/`zh-CN`/`pt` row (alias → tag; pinned); a cached device choice `zh` (`isStaticallyKnownLanguage` → `isBuiltInLanguage('zh')` true, so it is kept and renders `zh-Hans` through `fallbackLng`); a `zh-TW` browser with no choice (`pickInitialLanguage` → `zh-Hant`, previously `zh`); a `zh-Hant-HK` browser (alias); a deployment offering `zh-CN`+`zh-TW` for a stored `zh-HK` (`zh-TW`, via the table step); an instance in `zh-TW` whose `zh-Hant` catalogue lands after mount (reaches it, pinned); the marketplace lazy loader for a `zh-TW` session (tag-typed, `zh-Hant`); a `zh-Hans` date picker (`date-fns` `zh-CN` via `maximize()`); `Accept-Language: zh-Hant` to a server with `zh-CN` only (variant step → Simplified, the declared Studio/server state). The narrowing itself holds; the one must-fix is a gate the head reds, not the design.

Must-fix (a FAIL on this head):

- M1 `ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs:194–196` — the `en`-first assertion is a top-level `if … throw` in a `scripts/**` module that exports `LOCALES`, `FOLLOWERS`, `readPacks`, `analyze` and more, so importing the gate for its exports (its own test does; `check-entry-guard`'s rule is that a top-level `process.exit`/throw inside an importer is read as the importer's result) runs code on import. `ui/scripts/check-entry-guard.mjs` refuses it and the head's `Lint UI` check-run is red on exactly this line. Fix: move the assertion into a declaration — e.g. `export const LOCALES = Object.freeze(enFirstTableTags(PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS))` with the throw inside `enFirstTableTags` — so the module's top level only declares. (The PR has since received `143ef31d`, a one-file commit that does this; it is not the head this record names, and the seat re-renders the record there, with `Test UI (15/16)` measured.)

Should-fix (none blocks a corrected head):

- S1 `pickLocalized` / `localeWriteKey` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts`, unchanged): a `zh-Hant` session reading an inline map `{ 'zh-CN': …, 'zh-TW': … }` takes the first `zh-*` key (Simplified) and an edit in that session writes back to that same `zh-CN` entry. Not a regression (a `zh-TW` browser resolved to `zh` on `main` and did the same; a stored `zh-TW` still exact-matches), but after this PR the chrome is Traditional while authored labels are Simplified. The dev named it "follow-up candidate, not filed": file the card (teach both limbs the table's reading) before phase 4 lands.
- S2 `LocaleSwitcher.tsx` `BUILT_IN_LABELS` rows `zh` and `pt` are dead after this PR; `简体中文`, `繁體中文`, `Português (Brasil)` now come from `Intl.DisplayNames`, the ICU-dependent source the file's own header says it avoids. Phase 4 owns the menu; it should read `PLATFORM_LOCALES[].label` (the table carries exactly these names) and drop the hand map. `ProfilePage.tsx` already derives names and is unaffected.
- S3 `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` teaches ten packs with `zh` and `pt` — after this lands it teaches a retired key and module path. Governed Tier H, so a separate card/PR; file it before landing so the follow-up is a tracked card, not a line in a changeset.
- S4 Server catalogues (`packages/core` `memory-i18n`) and the `studio` namespace carry no `zh-Hant`; a Traditional Console shows Simplified server-translated labels and Studio strings. Both are declared (changeset, PR body, ruling #25922) and out of this card's lane; the tracking card #29428 should carry the server backfill as its own phase.
- S5 `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` lists only `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hant.ts` as `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED`; `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/zh-Hant.ts` is generated by the same command and belongs in the same ledger entry (or a second row), so the merge driver treats both alike.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-f2dhrw`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw7DekEe3wx5f3zphf`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

domain:ui#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw7DekEe3wx5f3zphf

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c1f166cc40e17e5a1c069137a6ffa32897da33fb`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the two files the delta since `f7e9df2d` touches — `ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`, `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` — plus, carried forward unchanged from record 6682790803 on `f7e9df2d`, every path of the diff outside the prose faces (152 files, identical file list, same merge base `98f640d5`; net diff vs `main` is now +7673/−824, i.e. the reviewed diff plus the +20/−3 below) + cited: `ui/scripts/check-entry-guard.mjs` (the gate M1 answered to), `packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/scripts/zh-hant.mjs` (`ZH_HANT_TARGETS`), `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/zh-hant-generated.test.ts`; nothing else re-read, nothing else needed.

### ① Derived judgments

Delta only; every judgment in 6682790803 ① stands for the 150 untouched files and is carried forward by reference.

- `ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` (commit `143ef31d`, +8/−3): the top-level `if (LOCALES[0] !== 'en') { throw … }` is gone; `LOCALES = Object.freeze(enFirstTableTags(PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS))` with the `en`-first refusal inside the hoisted function `enFirstTableTags`. The module's top level now only declares, which is the shape `check-entry-guard.mjs` demands of an exporting `scripts/**` file; the assertion still fires at import on a table that does not open with `en`, so the gate's own invariant is kept — RIGHT. No export added or removed (`LOCALES`, `FOLLOWERS`, `readPacks`, `analyze` and the CLI unchanged); the follower-absent-at-base rule and its tests are untouched.
- `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` (commit `c1f166cc`, +12/−0): a second `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` row for `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/zh-Hant.ts`, same `gen: 'gen:zh-hant'`, same owner, same currency-proof reasoning (the package test walks `ZH_HANT_TARGETS`, which names exactly these two targets) — RIGHT; closes S5 of 6682790803.
- No public surface, accept set, gate population or test moved beyond these two hunks (`git diff f7e9df2d c1f166cc` is these two files only).

Head check-runs on `c1f166cc` (the gate verdicts): all 57 completed; every one is `success` or `skipped` (the skipped ones are the opt-in/scheduled jobs: Temporal Conformance, UI Published Artifacts, Dogfood Verify CLI, the dogfood shard matrix, Schedule gate, Packed-tarball smoke, 18.x upgrade harness). Green includes the two that were not green on `f7e9df2d`: `Lint UI` (so `check:entry-guard` accepts the new shape — M1 closed by the gate that raised it) and `Test UI (15/16)` (measured this time, with shards 1–14 and 16 and the `Test UI` aggregate), plus Test Core (1/8, 2/8, aggregate), TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / source gates / debt ledger, Build Core, Build UI Deps, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Build Docs, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · ESLint, every scoped Lint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI/release/engine gates, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Validate Package Dependencies, Dogfood Regression Gate, Auto Label, filter. The gate verdict on this head is green.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from 6682790803 ②: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on PR body and changeset; `patch` on `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/console`; BREAKING banner, five FROM → TO lines, one ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The delta touches a ui gate script and a root tooling ledger, neither published, so the changeset needs no edit and got none. `Check Changeset` green on this head.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — carried forward; `patch` remains the right level.

### ③ Boundary flags

No new os-dev-report on the card since 6682318861; the two delta commits answer M1 and S5 of 6682790803 and raise no flag of their own. Everything else in 6682790803 ③ stands: S3 (`skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` follow-up card to be FILED before landing), S1 (`pickLocalized` card), Tier H approval via `os-zhuang`, close #30595 at landing. Nothing escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing itself is unchanged from `f7e9df2d` and the judgment in 6682790803 ④ carries forward: no declared capability of the published locale table is taken away at the consumer; stored and browser codes resolve through the table's read aliases; new writes are table tags the server accepts and serves. On the delta: M1 is closed in the tree (the only top-level statement that ran on import is now inside a declaration) and the head's `Lint UI` conclusion is the proof of record; S5 is closed. Remaining should-fix, none blocking, renumbered from 6682790803: S1 `pickLocalized`/`localeWriteKey` zh-Hant inline maps (file the card before phase 4); S2 `LocaleSwitcher` dead `zh`/`pt` label rows (phase 4 reads `PLATFORM_LOCALES[].label`); S3 `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` (Tier H, separate card, filed before landing); S4 server catalogues and `studio` namespace without `zh-Hant` (declared; tracking card #29428). No must-fix on this head.

Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw7DekEe3wx5f3zphf`
